0022600169.text: The Nuggets (3-2, 8th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (4-1, 1st in the Northwest), with Denver on a two-game winning streak and Portland on a one-game streak after going 3-0 on the road. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 137-132 home win over Portland on April 6, 2026.
